message:
The `customElement` option is used when generating a custom element. Did you forget the `customElement: true` compile option?
https://svelte.dev/e/options_missing_custom_element

Using `on:click` to listen to the click event is deprecated. Use the event attribute `onclick` instead
https://svelte.dev/e/event_directive_deprecated

`count` is updated, but is not declared with `$state(...)`. Changing its value will not correctly trigger updates
https://svelte.dev/e/non_reactive_update
